dataList.content:
She leans forward, going for the kill. I see it then—imbalance. A split-second opening. Narrow, but an opportunity nonetheless.
我察觉到了她因重心前倾而产生的刹那破绽。

It's the only pathway to the impossible future I had imagined tens of thousands of times in my mind...
哪怕我已经想象了成千上万次……也曾以为这个未来绝对不会到来……

... the future I had put off time and again, now merely milliseconds away, waiting for me to seize it.
而这个我一直在推迟的、仅有一次的未来正近在眼前。

Maybe I can end it now. Maybe this is my chance.
现在的话，说不定能杀了她。

That wandering thought cuts deeply through my psyche. As if possessed by some ghost, I raise my sword arm.
在那念头短暂地掠过脑海之时，我就像被什么东西附身了一般，将剑向前刺去……

Y-you...
你……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
I blink. Before I knew it, the sword in my hand had run through Master's heart.
回过神来的时候，我已经贯穿了师父的心脏。

It wasn't as if I had a momentary burst of determination, no. 
我并不是下了什么决心。

My body moved on its own—like a creature flinching and curling up just moments before a brutal thrashing. Only this time, it took the shape of a sword driven outward.
而是就像身体会在被殴打前本能地蜷缩起来一样……我的身体自己动了起来。

You... you little...! Heathcliff... You... You dare betray me, after everything...?
你……！希斯克利夫，你……你竟敢……！
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Her eyes widen, almost bulging out of their sockets with shock and resentment. I look on quietly, trying to capture every last detail as Master screams what will be her last words.
我看着眼中满是怨恨、声嘶力竭地吼叫着的师父，将这一幕的每个细节都深深刻入眼底。

I thought maybe I would feel the urge to pour out my anger on her, laying into her all the resentment I held in my heart. But I find neither there.
可我连对她宣泄怒火和倾诉恨意的念头都没有。

Unlike all those times I imagined it, there is no catharsis. No laughter.
不同于想象中的痛快，我连笑都笑不出来……

Not even the sudden surge of tears welling at the corners of my eyes. Nothing.
就连预料之外的悲伤，也没有停留在我的眼角。

Nothing but silence. All that noise in my head, gone. It's so quiet up there that even my heartbeat feels sedate.
我的脑海中一片寂静，因此感觉自己的心跳十分平稳。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢

The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
Yeah, well... Not a bad hell... to throw yourselves into.
是啊……这样的地狱……对你们来说……也不错。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢

dataList.content:
Like an ungrateful hound, I sank my fangs into the jugular of the woman who raised me.
我忘恩负义地咬住了养育自己之人的脖子。

But... this didn't feel like something I'd come to regret down the line.
然而……我对这个行动完全不感到后悔。

As to why that might be...
要说原因，恐怕……

... I suppose I must retrace this tale from the very beginning—starting with Yoshihide, the woman who has brought this hellish scene to the House of Spiders.
要从创作出这地狱般光景的<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>、那家伙的故事开始回忆了。

The Nursefathers hardly got along amongst themselves.
父辈们彼此间关系并不好。

It did not take long for me to learn as much after my arrival at the House of Spiders.
这个事实我在进入蜘蛛巢没几天时就知道了。

Master spent most days hurling profanities at the other Nursefathers, and they would always return the favour by shooting demeaning looks at her as she drunkenly stumbled around.
师父几乎每天都在痛骂他们，而其他父辈则会在师父醉酒时，用看可悲之物的眼神轻蔑着她。

Whenever their look of contempt fell on her (and fall harshly they did), she would snap at me instead, picking apart my behaviour to find the tiniest fault and slapping me across the face.
每当她感受到那种视线时，师父就会不耐烦地责备我的行为，然后打我的耳光。

I used to believe it was a punishment for my lack of "propriety," but...
一开始我还以为那些体罚是因为我欠缺礼仪……

... Well, it's become rather obvious now that she just needed a punchbag to vent her frustrations on.
嘛，到头来只是她需要一个出气筒罢了。

dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Though the Nursefathers were far from fond of each other, there was one exception.
在互相不对付的父辈之中，只有一个人例外。

The Nursefather of the Pinky.
小指父辈。

They were all careful around her, that woman whose face was always shrouded under a veil.
只有那位总是用面纱遮住脸的人，所有的父辈都会小心对待。

The Middle Nursefather, whenever she left the House for whatever reason, would never forget to bring fruits or health supplements for the Pinky Nursefather...
中指父辈每次出门的时候，都会去买好要带给小指父辈的水果和药材……

... and the Index Nursefather prepared and brought her delicious food every meal, or sometimes sat by the shut door of her room to read her a book.
食指父辈每次都会为她准备食物，有时还会坐在门前给她读书。

Even the Ring Nursefather would sometimes hesitate and pace in front of her Corridor, before finally deciding to slip a neatly folded message under the door that he had completed a new piece of art.
环指父辈有时也同样会在她的走廊前徘徊，再留下一张整齐叠好、写有新作品已经完成的纸张。

My master, the Thumb Nursefather... also seemed to harbour a similar affection for the veiled woman.
身为拇指父辈的师父也是一样……有着差不多的温和态度。

The difference was that she did not seem willing to go and see the Pinky Nursefather herself, whether because she could not be bothered to do so or couldn't swallow her own pride.
如果要说有什么不同的话……是她不喜欢亲自去跑一趟，还是那会伤害到她的自尊心呢。

She'd always send me instead to check in on the Pinky Nursefather and deliver the news back to her.
她总是派我过去询问小指父辈、那位大人的状态如何了。

It was hardly any trouble, but I never liked doing it. It always made my skin crawl, for whatever reason.
虽然不是什么难事，但我总对这个任务感到毛骨悚然。

dataList.title:
The Pinky Nursefather
小指 父辈
dataList.content:
... So, she has sent you here again?
……那个人又让你过来了啊。

dataList.title:
The Pinky Nursefather
小指 父辈
dataList.content:
Sinclair. See your fellow Apprentice away, if you would.
辛克莱。既然你们同为子辈，就去送送他吧。

dataList.title:
The Pinky Nursefather
小指 父辈
dataList.content:
I... am not in the mood to receive a guest.
我现在……不太想见客。

... It will be done, Master.
……明白了。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
Pray walk with this humble self of mine, Heathcliff. Master has no wish to converse with anyone today.
希斯克利夫。请随小生来吧。主人说今日不想与人交谈。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
There was always a look of pity in her eyes that gleamed from behind the veil. Pity meant for me, for Sinclair, and all of us Apprentices.
我透过面纱所见到的那双眼睛，总是对我、不，对以辛克莱那家伙为首的子辈们抱有同情。

Why would a prisoner of the House of Spiders, forced to helplessly watch the fast-approaching end of her own life, still have pity to spare for us?
为什么一个被囚禁在蜘蛛巢中、即将因病衰亡的人……会那般地同情我们呢。

None of the Apprentices seemed to know the answer to that question.
那原因看样子似乎没有子辈知道。

Not even Sinclair, her own Apprentice and caretaker.
就连贴身侍奉小指父辈的辛克莱也一样。

I had long given up on having that part of the mystery answered, but... as it turns out, whenever Master began to ramble, she had a hard time stopping herself.
我曾以为解开那个疑问的机会恐怕永远不会来了……但师父的话有时会停不下来。

It was one of those days when Master beat me until the bones of my limbs cracked and fractured, this time because I accidentally spoke too casually to... Miss Don Quixote, having mistaken her to be a fellow titleless Apprentice and not an officially anointed Proxy of the Index.
被称作堂吉诃德……的那位大人，我不知道她成为了正式的代行者而使用了随意的口吻，便被师父打断了四肢的那一天。

Downing a few bottles of liquor had activated her tongue, and she began telling another story she could not end. I braced myself, expecting another long-winded recounting of the Smoke War, only to be struck by something else entirely...
师父在几瓶酒下肚后，提起了与常说的烟霾战争不同的话题。

It was about her "Golden Ticket."
是关于她自己的“黄金奖券”的话题。

Ya... Ya gotta thank Ticket, ya hear me?
你……你也得感谢券券。明白吗？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
She's the only reason ya didn't end up another dead vagrant in that Backstreets...
本该在后巷中落魄死去的你会出现在这里……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
It's all 'cuz of what happened to Ticket after she ran away from home.
都是因为券券离家出走，害得我们吃尽了苦头啊。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Ran away from home, Master? The very same who fled from the House after "completing all of those tasks single-handedly"?
离家……出走的，是经受了所有考验后再离开家中的那位吗？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
... Fuck, Heathcliff. Didya really have to bring up that bitch when I'm drinkin'? Ya sure know how to make good booze taste like shit, don'tcha?
……操，这话让酒都变难喝了。为什么要提那个混蛋的事？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Apologies, Master.
十分抱歉……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Bitch takes after her mommy, that's why.
那个混蛋会离家出走，也全都是因为像她母亲。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Yeah, come to think of it... Ticket couldn't take it either. Scampered off alone into that wide, unforgiving world out there as if that place was any kinder.
其实券券那时候也受不了，匆匆忙忙地逃到外面去了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
*puff*
呼……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
See, though the House of Spiders is kinda like a retirement home for the has-beens... We ain't nobodies, ya know?
虽然这所蜘蛛巢是个聚集了落魄之人的地方……但我们某种程度上运气也挺好的，你知道吗？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
This is the Finger's casino, and they're all waiting for the Jackpot to drop, ya catch my drift? All five Fingers've got their eyes on this project.
就算烂掉了，这里依然是个……机遇之地啊。所有手指都在注视着这个重要的项目。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Someone with such aptitude just up and leaving the House of Spiders... You can imagine the kind of shit that stirred up.
既然有适配者从这样的蜘蛛巢中逃走了……接下来……操，不就明摆着了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
The Fingers... tracked her down?
手指们……在追踪她吗？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yeah. The Thumb, the Index, and all kinds of motherfuckers the City has to offer went snappin' at her heels until she couldn't take it anymore... and returned home.
是啊。拇指啊、食指啊……她被那些混蛋们追赶着……回到了家。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Comin' home with a baby in her arms was a bit fucked up, but... Whatever, right?
虽然她抱着一个小鬼回来很让人震惊……但也没啥问题吧。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
She wasn't dead, and the Project was now back on track. Or so we thought.
她活着回来了……我们也曾觉得这对计划没有影响。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
'Cuz it was "too late" or something, accordin' to Yi Sang.
可……李箱那混蛋分明说过。似乎已经来不及了之类的话。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
That's when I first learned that the Pinky motherfuckers can't use another Relic once they've chosen one for themselves.
那时候我才知道，小指那帮混蛋的遗物，一旦选了其中一件，其他的就不能再用了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
And Ticket, well... Tsk, she picked the Dihui Star's Blade over Tiansha Star's.
券券她……啧，选的不是天杀星刀，而是地慧星刀。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
We were fucked beyond any chance of redemption. Whatever our bosses ended up dishing out, we had to take it.
当时我们觉得完蛋了……这样下去，上面说出什么样子的屁话都不奇怪。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Good thing she ended up passing on that unique aptitude to that mongrel brat of hers.
幸好……那个和她以血相连的孩子有着天赋。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
So, we decided to start over from scratch with the new girl.
所以我们决定重新再教一次。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Speeding things along with a workaround.
用捷径去尽快加速。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
Ah, then the "new girl," is the one who is currently away from the House—?
所以，那位就是如今离家出走的……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yeah. Yoshihide, that bitch.
没错。<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>，那个混蛋。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
What if she chooses to simply... never return, Master?
如果她不回来的话……您会怎么做？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Hah, I'm not worried. She'll be back.
哈。不，那个混蛋肯定会回来的。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
'Cuz she's got somethin' Ticket doesn't.
因为券券身上没有的东西，在<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>的身上有。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Nursefather
拇指 父辈

dataList.content:
And that's all she ever said on that matter. She quietly downed a few more bottles before sleep took her.
师父在这番话的最后，沉默着又喝了几瓶酒，睡着了。

Something "Ticket" doesn't have, but Yoshihide does...
券券的身上没有，而<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>的身上却有的东西。

It was a riddle without a clue, let alone an answer.
而我听到这谜一般问题的答案，是在……

The first threads that formed the solution came later, when I had the opportunity to face Yoshihide as her "Textbook."
过了一段时间后，我作为教材和那个叫<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>的人面对面的时候。
I won't lose... Not to you. 如果对手是你……至少我不会输。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
I've watched and heard the same things you've been taught until they're etched into my memories.
因为我已经听过太多次、看过太多回了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
... Get out of my way.
……让开。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
I'm not wasting any more time on my inferior copy.
我没时间浪费在自己的仿造品上，让开。

... Oi, lass. Lemme ask ya somethin'.
……喂。我问你一句。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yoshihide had sought asylum in an upstart enterprise called Limbus Company.
<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>在逃走后藏身的地方……是名叫边狱公司的新兴公司。

I found the records of the assistance they provided her—securing an infiltration route into the House of Spiders, in-depth research projects into Relics, and the like.
再次进入蜘蛛巢的路线，以及对遗物的详细研究。

In short, it seemed at the time that the company was committed to helping Yoshihide.
除此之外，还有她在那里接受的大大小小的协助的记录。

When I'd first begun my investigation at the behest of my master, it felt as though I was uncovering the fringes of an unknown, significant force gearing up to help Yoshihide strike the House of Spiders down with overwhelming might.
在我按照师父的命令开始第一次调查的时候，还以为<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>说不定真的会率领什么大型势力回来。

But the more my investigation progressed, it soon became obvious that no such calamity would come to pass.
但我越是深入调查，越是明白那种事情是不可能的。

Limbus Company refused to provide Yoshihide any further support beyond that,
边狱公司拒绝提供更进一步的协助。

and they'd even cancelled the so-called "Operation Spider Pyre."
名为蜘蛛巢焚灭讨伐战的作战也被完全废弃。

So... what is it that keeps her moving?
既然如此……这不就已经结束了吗？

... Why are you clawin' your way back home, anyway?
……为什么你还要回来呢？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
After the way they've treated you... why?
明明你遭受过如此残酷的对待，却又要特意回来……为什么？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Now that her plan to involve an external party had fallen through...
既然她引入外部势力的计划已经失败了……

... there was no chance that Yoshihide, no matter how hard she tried, would be able to overcome the combined might of all Nursefathers and Apprentices.
那么她无论多么拼命地挣扎，一个人也没法和所有的父辈与子辈为敌。

Yoshihide had to have known that—she was no fool. But she pursued the Backdoor to the House of Spiders nonetheless.
<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>不可能不知道那件事，却还是走进了通往蜘蛛巢的后门。

As though it had always been her plan to take on the House all by herself.
就好像从一开始她就决定要独自了断一切一样。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
Because, in that hell...
因为在那片奈落之中……

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
... awaits someone who is more precious to me than anything in the world.
还留有我最为珍重的人。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
And the monsters I hate just as much.
以及那些我最为憎恶的怪物们。

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
Because without severing all of those threads that bind me...
直到将一切因缘全都了断为止，我……

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
... I can never truly be free from there.
都不会自由。

dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
... Why don't you run away yourself?
……你为什么不逃？

dataList.title:
The House of Spiders
蜘蛛巢
dataList.content:
It's obvious they're treating you like an animal. I can see it on you. That's how bad it is.
光看外表就全明白了吧。你也没受到过什么正常的对待。

That's...
那是……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
I could not answer Yoshihide's question, even as our duel came to an end with her shoving me to the ground.
我……在被<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>的刀锋击倒前……都没能回答上来那个问题。

How could I, when even my own heart was foreign to me then?
虽然我每次都下定决心必须要杀了她，可每到那时却又总在找借口拖延……

When I did not recognize all the times I had decided to put an end to it, only to find a convenient excuse to dally and postpone?
那时候的我连自己的内心所想都无法理解。

The first time I truly began to ponder Yoshihide's question...
我开始深入思考那个问题的答案……

... was after the Pinky Nursefather and Sinclair had betrayed the House of Spiders.
是在小指父辈和辛克莱背叛了蜘蛛巢之后。

You serious about goin' with that lady? Turnin' your back on us?
为什么要背叛啊。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
C'mon. I know your master don't beat you like mine does, but she's hardly been kind to you.
虽然她不会揍你……但你也没受到过什么好的对待吧。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Because this moment, had I allowed it to pass, would have lingered for the rest of my life as a profound regret.
小生觉得若是错失了这条道，这将会成为……一生的遗憾。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
What?
什么？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
My master treated me with such aversion, yes...
主人残酷地对待小生的原因……
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yet it was not for the lack of affection, as it is with your own Nursefather.
就和您的父辈一样，并非是没有爱。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
It is only that she has seen far too often what happens to those she cares about.
而是知晓自己曾经温柔对待的那些人们的末路。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
Thus I pose the selfsame question to you:
……反过来，请由小生向您发问。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
Why do you pledge your loyalty to her, still?
您为何……仍旧追随着那位大人呢。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
You have already done all the duty that true propriety demands of you. What more ought you repay?
您理应尽到了所有应守的礼节……难道还有什么应当回报的事情吗？
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
I've... I have? Me?
所有……应守的……？我吗？
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
... Let the end of your wandering be swift and conclusive.
……衷心希望您不要迷茫太久。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
When that time comes, even the simplest causality shall appear opaque, even the path laid before you cloaked as though under a haze.
等到那时来临，又会发生什么……即便是十分简单的因果关系，也会变得难以思索。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
My humble self shall now depart. Pray, do not pursue us.
小生便就此失礼了。若是可以的话，希望您不要追来。
dataList.title:
The Pinky Apprentice
小指 子辈

dataList.content:
I have already given her all that my heart could pour out,
将能付出的真心全部奉上，

and I have served her with utter propriety that my mind could afford.
将能尽到的礼仪全部敬上。

If all of that were still insufficient to fill the void in her heart, then what could?
即便如此她仍不能满足的话……师父的内心要用什么才能填满呢。

What she wanted—fame, honour, recognition—I could not give.
名声、荣誉、功勋。那样的东西我无法给予。

Acknowledgement from a thing so lowly as myself would mean nothing to her.
若是想给予足以满足师父的认可，我的身份又是这样地卑贱。

Then...
那样的话……

If there really is no other way...
如果真的没有办法的话……

I sink deeper into the well of my own mind, and at its bed I find Yoshihide's parting words to me.
在我思考的时候，<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>留下的话语突然浮现了出来。

Will Master one day come to regret her actions and change herself?
总有一天……师父会改变想法，为自己的行动感到后悔吗？

... No, she won't.
不会有那天的……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Should I choose to leave, here and now, would I find true freedom?
就算我这样逃走，自由对我来说也不存在吧。

No, I can... never truly be free like that.
我这一生……都无法获得自由吧。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
... Maybe the only way to really be free is... to end it all with my own hands.
……只能杀死了吧。为了将这一切都终结。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Even on that day, I could not say out loud what or whom it was that I wanted to end.
那一天我也没能说出自己必须要杀死的是谁。

But whether that was my master or myself...
但无论那个人是师父还是我自己。

... there was a low but impulsive voice, a tight pull from the pit of my stomach telling me maybe I could finally put an end to this, whatever that looked like.
我都被那股似乎只有我才能了断这一切的冲动所驱使……

So, I put a makeshift splint on my broken leg and hobbled through the Backdoor.
我用夹板固定好了断腿，向着后门走去。

And that brings us to the present.
而那行动的结果就是现在。

First came the self-loathing.
对自身的厌恶感。

Then the exhilaration of finally having gotten it over with.
终于结束的解脱感。

And... now that all was said and done, came aimlessness.
以及……因不知道自己接下来该做什么而到来的茫然感。

... What do I do now?
……接下来我该做什么呢。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
I stand before Yoshihide and watch as she endlessly severs away at the world around her. There is no light behind her eyes.
在面前停下的<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>只是带着空虚的目光将所触及的一切全都斩断而已。

A sad end to someone who has lost the most precious thing in the world to her. A living corpse animated only by its unquenchable wrath and hatred until even that fury lost any meaning it once had.
连重要之物都已经失去，只是将自身交予怒火与憎恶而挥刀的末路。

I... don't want to be here anymore.
我不想……再呆在这里了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
This place has a way of driving people completely mad.
这个空间有时会让人陷入疯狂。

Suddenly, a terrible omen strikes through me—if I dally here any longer, it will mean my ruin. I hurriedly scan around me for what remains of the House.
“如果一直在这里呆下去，是不会迎来什么好结果的”，突如其来的感觉让我环顾起了四周。

After all, the Backstreets makes for a cold home for the poor, no matter what terrible violence I have suffered here.
毕竟虽然这里的生活充斥着暴力，但后巷的寒冷也不会因此就变得暖和。

dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
... I ain't sure which of these'll fetch me a nice coin.
……不知道哪些值钱啊。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Guess I'll pocket them shiny bits, and those expensive bottles of liq—
闪闪发光的东西啥的……那瓶酒也很贵吧……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
My heart sinks the moment I catch a glimpse of her liquor bar.
就在酒瓶闯入我视野中的那瞬，心脏向下沉没的感觉突然攥住了我。

A mere glance, and the floodgate of my memories cracks open with little resistance; I recall the sensation of those same glass bottles breaking into a thousand, lacerating shards against my head... and Master, downing bottle after bottle like she was throwing back water.
只是看着，被那个瓶子殴打的记忆……以及师父用那东西喝酒的记忆……都苏醒了。

Revulsion, too, rears its head. Reality settles around me, and I am nothing but a disgusting traitor who has acted out of impulse and run his sword through his master's heart, all for a desperate struggle to end it all.
以及对为了给一切做个了断，而将利刃插入师父心脏的自己的厌恶感也涌了上来。

Ah, I see...
啊……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
If I am to be happy...
如果是为了我能获得幸福的话……
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
I shoved everything that seemed even remotely expensive into my pack.
我将看上去值钱的东西装进了包。

I took Master's swords. Her eye, too.
师父的剑和眼睛也被装了进去。

I don't know if I'll pawn them off or use them myself, but...
虽然我不知道该去哪里卖掉它们，也不知道要用的话该怎么使用……

... they're questions for another day. Today, I make a decision for myself.
但那些烦恼就留到以后了，我在心中做出了另一个决定。

dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yoshihide continues to cut away at nothing and everything all at once.
<ruby=Yoshihide>良秀</ruby>仍只是将一切全都斩断。

And there lies a cold, lifeless corpse at my feet...
就在她的正前方，有一具倒下的尸体……

I'll probably find more dead bodies not so far from here.
以及，在不远处……还有好几个死人。

Yeah. I know what I must do. It's never been clearer than this.
是啊。我只是明确地知道自己该做什么了而已。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
If I do this, it'll all go away forever. No matter what I look at, it won't come back.
这样一来，无论我看到什么……都再也不会想起来了。
dataList.title:
The Thumb Apprentice
拇指 子辈

dataList.content:
Free of desires, free of remorse.
没有任何期望、没有任何回望。

Feeling the tangled web of emotions that once bound me fall away, unraveling...
我感受着曾经复杂纠缠着的感情一点点解开……

... I leave my home in silence.
静静地离开了家。
